verdict.rationale: An LLM gateway could plausibly offer a training opt-out, such as routing only to providers that do not train on customer data, so this axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on training opt-outs, data-use policies or no-training provider filters. Guardrails (scanning for sensitive content), EU routing (data residency) and BYOK are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.
